candidates.description: These tokens function as French modal, temporal, and conjunctive adverbs that modify verbs, adjectives, or entire clauses to express time, frequency, degree, or logical connection.
This vector represents actions, transitions, or interruptions involving movement, breaks, and changes in state.
This feature vector represents words, prefixes, and abbreviations related to competition, sporting events, and the French interrogative or relative pronouns.
This feature vector activates strongly on words and subwords containing the letter sequence "rupt" or related root forms associated with breaking, interruption, or specific morphological suffixes.
This feature vector represents French conjugated verb forms, particularly auxiliaries and common verbs indicating states of being, necessity, or possibility.
This vector represents words, prefixes, or substrings containing the letters "sur" related to surfing or the sound "sur".
This feature vector represents concepts related to coastal, marine, and aquatic environments or geography.
This feature vector activates strongly on French personal pronouns and related grammatical markers.
This feature vector activates strongly on the French word root "qu" and words containing it, such as "qui," "quoi," and "quand."
This vector represents common French derivational prefixes, root morphemes, and utility-related terms frequently found in technical or formal vocabulary.
